visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera moves through a large mouth-shaped entrance into a dimly lit, red-walled tunnel resembling a human digestive tract. The walls are textured to look like muscle fibers, and there are hanging organic shapes and educational posters along the path. (2) A man with shoulder-length wavy hair, wearing a black beanie and a multicolored striped cardigan, appears in a medium close-up shot inside the red-lit exhibit, looking at the camera. (3) The camera captures various textures of the exhibit: floor projections showing swirling cellular patterns and walls covered in dense, yellow finger-like protrusions mimicking intestinal villi. The path leads to a circular exit shaped like a sphincter, with brown spiral stool-shaped chairs nearby. (4) The man walks through the sphincter-shaped exit into a brightly lit area. He stands in front of the camera, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. Yellow subtitles and variety-show style text appear on the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male speaker introduces the video with a friendly, conversational tone at a moderate speech rate. An upbeat acoustic guitar and drum rhythm play as background music. Faint ambient room tone and distant children's chatter are audible in the background. (2) The narration pauses briefly, allowing the rhythmic BGM to become more prominent. (3) A series of wet, squelching 'digestion' sound effects begin, layered prominently over the BGM. These effects are rhythmic and heavy in spectral bandwidth, mimicking the sound of internal organ movement. (4) The male speaker continues his narration over the squelching sound effects, maintaining a cheerful tone. The BGM remains consistent in tempo. (5) The squelching SFX reach a peak intensity as the speaker delivers a humorous closing remark. The BGM fades out gradually as the speech ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle vlog documenting a visit to a unique interactive exhibition themed around the human digestive system. The creator uses humorous narration and on-site visuals to provide a 'first-person experience' of traveling through the body, concluding with a lighthearted remark about taking the correct path.
